doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Live big-band and chamber orchestra recordings in the studio
summary: She recorded a whole live big band album, and 13 & 3/4 with a chamber orchestra, in the same room with engineer Tom Mark.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Well that record I’m talkin’ about, we had a whole live album, made a big band, all standing in the three rows right at that wall. Trumpets, trombones, reeds, organ, piano, bass drums, in one room. And we did it all live. And then also the record called the 13 & 3/4, those recordings were done with a chamber symphony orchestra right in this room.
Tom Mark. Ok, so he was the engineer for all those?
